name: Zed
title: the Master of Shadows

Q.name: Razor Shuriken
Q.description: Zed and his Shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing 80/120/160/200/240 + 1×bonus AD physical damage to the first enemy they pass through, and (80/120/160/200/240 + 1×bonus AD) × 0.6 physical damage to each additional enemy.
Q.summary: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens. Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

W.name: Living Shadow
W.description: Passive: Zed gains 30/35/40/45/50 Energy whenever he and his Shadows strike an enemy with the same Ability. Active: Zed's Shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for 5 seconds. Recasting this Ability will cause Zed to switch positions with this Shadow.
W.summary: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability. Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

E.name: Shadow Slash
E.description: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing 70/92.5/115/137.5/160 + 0.7×bonus AD physical damage to nearby enemies. Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by 3 seconds. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by 30/37.5/45/52.5/60% instead.
E.summary: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.

R.name: Death Mark
R.description: Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds, the mark triggers, dealing 1×AD physical damage and repeating 25/40/55.0% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active. The dash leaves a Shadow behind for 7.5 seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.
R.summary: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

Passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
Passive.description: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.
Passive.summary: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Energy assassin who uses W shadows to double his Q and E, then marks and executes with an untargetable R. Bursts squishy targets and roams, weak to crowd control and tanks.
strengths: Strong poke with W+Q from shadows
R is untargetable and kills squishies
weaknesses: Weak if W is down (no escape, no double Q)
Energy runs out in long trades
Falls off vs tanky or Zhonya's/QSS teams
Weak level 1–2 vs strong early lanes
profile.curveNote: Wants W+E+Q (level 3) for full trades; level 6 for kills.

Q.notes: Shuriken from Zed and shadows; overlapping hits do less.

W.notes: Shadow dash/swap: his escape. Shadows copy Q and E.

E.notes: Slows when a shadow's E hits.

R.notes: Untargetable dash; mark pops for a share of damage dealt.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: he can't escape or poke with shadows; all-in. Also when low on energy.
